coldConnectionComparison.comparison: Six alternating pairs on the same local network and same CloudBase revision. Fresh curl process and connection for each documented public request; this is a single resource, not a browser page timing.

actualChromeCandidateTrial.method: Live Chrome navigation over HTTPS to the real storefront, no fulfilled/replayed assets. New cold context per sample. Candidate redirects only the first anonymous matching GET at the JavaScript call boundary, and only before running fetch.
actualChromeCandidateTrial.decision: Test a scoped public list change with real session and routing regression before rollout. Faster download does not prove LCP improvement or warmed connection reuse.

actualChromeListStartTrace.finding: The live list mounts inside the lazily loaded product-preview wrapper. In both samples the first list request follows the last required preview download by at most 50 ms. The main thread was busy for under one second over the entire elapsed period.
actualChromeListStartTrace.scope: Two traces localize the dependency in this mobile profile. No change to JavaScript loading order or list routing was deployed from this experiment.

preparingCountryPickerAtProductOpenTrial.method: Paired local builds from the accepted website source and snapshot, with read-only requests relayed to the actual public website. Candidate starts loading the separated React Aria country picker after the product detail renders.
preparingCountryPickerAtProductOpenTrial.decision: Keep the existing script order. The fast path into the inquiry still waits multiple additional seconds for the country picker.

initialPublicPriceCandidate.source: Already-public anonymous catalog page matched by existing approved product identity.
initialPublicPriceCandidate.scope: Full original inventory, with approved list price summaries from one verified public response added to the candidate test input. The release performs full fresh acquisition.

anonymousListPreloadTrial.design: Same archived website HTML is supplied by the experiment. Chrome reads the official static asset URLs directly from the live site, under simulated mobile conditions. Actual Chrome makes GETs to the current public backend. Candidate adds one native CORS fetch preload for the exact default public list request in the HTML head. No request interception or custom data cache.
anonymousListPreloadTrial.decision: Not released. Fetch completion advanced, with a single actual API request per visit, while the buyer-facing filter and image showed no improvement in this experiment. HTML timing excludes a production HTML request.

controlledChromeTrial.design: Same archived storefront files sent from one local HTTP server with cold Chrome sessions. The public list response is an exact captured reply and repeat public API/first-party image data is replayed from memory. Only the critical preview JS is transmitted with or without gzip. This is not a cloud latency or edge trial.

storefrontPreviewScriptCompression.decision: No production edge change. This isolates one file transfer, justifying the static-only edge pilot once the DNS, certificate and usage prerequisites are available.
